retention.logs_description: Full requests with headers and bodies. Lowering it deletes older logs at the next hourly prune.
retention.statistics_description: Per-day aggregates behind charts and KPIs. Sets the longest period you can pick.

capture.max_body_description: Larger request and response bodies are stored truncated and flagged.

capture.headers_hint: Header names, lower case. Values under secret-looking names are still redacted.

thresholds.slow_description: Requests above this are flagged slow; a route whose average is above it is listed as Slow.
thresholds.error_rate_description: Routes above this share of 4xx are flagged. Any 5xx marks a route as Failing.
